1.title: Troy Jackson, a Progressive Brawler, Tries to Flip a Senate Seat in Maine
1.summary: Mr. Jackson landed in the race unexpectedly. Democrats are hoping he can unseat Susan Collins, a Republican, in their bid to retake the Senate.

2.title: Trump Says His D.C. Arch Would Be a ‘Military Complex’ Housing Drones and Snipers
2.summary: The president’s announcement on Sunday echoed his justification for the White House ballroom: that the project was necessary for national security.

3.title: American Yom Kippur: How Jews Across the U.S. Observe the Holiest Day of the Year
3.summary: From 200-mile treks to synagogue to spiritual striving, readers  share the rituals that define Judaism’s holiest day for them.

4.title: German Chancellor Merz vows to stay on despite 'disaster' in state election
4.summary: Exit polls show damaging losses for Merz's centre-right CDU party in the states of Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.

5.title: Far Right Appears to Fall Short of Power in New German Elections
5.summary: Elections in eastern Germany on Sunday appeared to show gains for the Alternative for Germany and bad news for the party of Chancellor Friedrich Merz.

6.title: Trump says his planned triumphal arch will double as a military complex to store ammunition
6.summary: Trump said the updated plans were at the request of the US military and for national security purposes.
